summary: Updated three pages. Ansible's argocd runbook now describes the deploy-repo producer on architectureProducer's steps, declaring its own trigger and guard, and drops PipelinesDeploy's stale 'style guide's form' case; registry-switch now names Argo's exact branch key (2e0bb09 on phase/035-docs). JenkinsPipelineUtils' app-architecture type page covers the backend/frontend producers and IoTSupport's generate stage (e62b3dc on main). The docs gate (mkdocs --strict, check_site.py) is green; Ansible has no doc gate. No claim was left unverified. Doc debt in repos this slice cannot commit to went to the close-out (AnsibleSpecs abea534): a note on P2 (Architecture USAGE.md), P6 (KubeCoder) and P7 (ArgoCDTools).
